description: Complete consistent Henkin sets agreeing on their common formulas have isomorphic common reducts of their term models under an isomorphism sending every name class \([d_n]_1\) to \([d_n]_2\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.common_term_isomorphism.{u, v} {L₀ L₁ L₂ : FirstOrder.Language}
  {j₁ : L₀ →ᴸ L₁} {j₂ : L₀ →ᴸ L₂} {U : Set (L₁.Formula ℕ)} {V : Set (L₂.Formula ℕ)}
  (hU : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent U)
  (hUC : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Complete U)
  (hUH : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Henkin U)
  (hV : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent V)
  (hVC : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Complete V)
  (hVH : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Henkin V)
  (h : ∀ (A : L₀.Formula ℕ), j₁.onFormula A ∈ U ↔ j₂.onFormula A ∈ V) :
  ∃ e,
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      e (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.nameValue U hU hUC n) =
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.nameValue V hV hVC n
